text.id: Selamat datang, Maba! Gue Bang Jarwo, semester 13. Satu tips dari gue: jangan jadi kayak gue.
text.en: Welcome, freshman! I'm Bang Jarwo, 13th semester. One tip from me: don't end up like me.

result.id: Bang Jarwo menepuk pundakmu. "Semangat. Nanti juga ngerti."
result.en: Bang Jarwo pats your shoulder. "Hang in there. You'll get it eventually."

result.id: "Panjang ceritanya. Dospem gue dinas dari 2019."
result.en: "Long story. My advisor's been on a work trip since 2019."

text.id: Hai! Aku Sari, kita satu kelompok ospek kemarin. Mau gabung grup belajar bareng?
text.en: Hi! I'm Sari, we were in the same orientation group. Want to join our study group?

result.id: Kamu resmi punya bestie. Hidup terasa sedikit lebih ringan.
result.en: You officially have a bestie. Life feels a little lighter.

result.id: Sari tetap memasukkanmu ke grup. "Nggak usah aktif, yang penting ada."
result.en: Sari adds you to the group anyway. "You don't have to talk, just be there."

text.id: {name}, kamu kelihatan capek banget akhir-akhir ini. Mau cerita? UPT Konseling kampus gratis lho, aku temenin.
text.en: {name}, you've looked really exhausted lately. Want to talk? The campus counseling unit is free, I'll come with you.

label.en: Yeah... come with me to counseling.

result.id: Bu Laras mendengarkan tanpa menghakimi. Ternyata cerita itu melegakan. (Kamu bisa pilih aksi Konseling Kampus kapan saja di slot siang.)
result.en: Bu Laras listens without judging. Talking actually helps. (You can pick Campus Counseling any time in the afternoon slot.)

result.id: "Oke... tapi aku di sini ya kalau kamu butuh." Tolong jaga energi & mentalmu.
result.en: "Okay... but I'm here if you need me." Please watch your energy and mental health.

text.id: SK Pembimbing keluar! Dosen pembimbing skripsimu: {dospem}. Semoga beruntung.
text.en: The advisor decree is out! Your thesis advisor: {dospem}. Good luck.

result.id: Mulai sekarang ada aksi Garap Skripsi dan Bimbingan Dospem (siang). Draf harus ditulis, lalu di-ACC.
result.en: You can now pick Write Thesis and Advisor Meeting (afternoon). Write the draft, then get it approved.

text.id: SIDANG SKRIPSI. Penguji membolak-balik draftmu lalu bertanya: "Kenapa kamu memilih metode ini?"
text.en: THESIS DEFENSE. The examiner flips through your draft and asks: "Why did you choose this method?"

result.id: "Baik. Selamat, Anda LULUS sidang!" Kamu hampir pingsan karena lega.
result.en: "Very well. Congratulations, you PASSED!" You nearly faint from relief.

fail_result.id: "Konsepnya belum matang. Revisi mayor, sidang ulang."
fail_result.en: "The concept isn't ready. Major revisions, defend again."

label.en: Ultimate move: "That's a limitation of the study."

result.id: Penguji tertawa. "Jawaban klasik. Oke, lulus dengan revisi minor."
result.en: The examiner laughs. "Classic answer. Fine, pass with minor revisions."

fail_result.id: "Semua jadi limitasi kalau begitu. Sidang ulang."
fail_result.en: "Then everything's a limitation. Defend again."

text.id: Selamat datang di Desa Sukamaju, adik-adik KKN! Kami butuh program kerja. Sinyal cuma ada di atas pohon jambu.
text.en: Welcome to Sukamaju Village, KKN students! We need a work program. The only signal is on top of the guava tree.

result.id: Warga antusias. Kamu naik pohon jambu tiap hari buat upload laporan.
result.en: The villagers are thrilled. You climb the guava tree daily to upload reports.

result.id: Plang selesai dalam 3 hari. Warga senang, kamu bisa tidur.
result.en: Signs done in 3 days. Villagers happy, you can sleep.

text.id: "Nak... Ayah kena PHK. Pabriknya tutup. Mulai semester ini Ayah belum bisa bayar UKT-mu. Kiriman juga cuma bisa sedikit."
text.en: "Kid... Dad got laid off. The factory closed. Starting this semester I can't pay your tuition. I can only send a little each month."

result.id: Ayah terdiam lama. "Maafin Ayah ya." Mulai sekarang UKT & hidupmu tanggung sendiri. Cek Papan Lowongan.
result.en: Dad is quiet for a long time. "I'm sorry." From now on, tuition and living costs are on you. Check the Job Board.

result.id: Kamu menutup telepon dan menatap langit-langit kos lama sekali. Opsi: kerja part-time, banding UKT, beasiswa, atau cuti.
result.en: You hang up and stare at the ceiling for a long time. Options: part-time work, tuition appeal, scholarship, or a leave semester.

text.id: PENGUMUMAN: UKT semester depan naik 25% "demi peningkatan mutu layanan". Mahasiswa geram, BEM siap demo.
text.en: ANNOUNCEMENT: Next semester's tuition rises 25% "to improve service quality". Students are furious; the student union plans a protest.

result.id: Aksi damai ribuan mahasiswa viral. Kenaikan UKT DIBATALKAN!
result.en: A peaceful protest of thousands goes viral. The tuition hike is CANCELLED!

fail_result.id: Demo diterima Rektor, "akan dikaji". Kenaikan tetap berlaku.
fail_result.en: The rector receives the protesters, "it will be reviewed". The hike goes ahead.

result.id: UKT naik. Rebahan tidak menurunkan UKT, ternyata.
result.en: Tuition went up. Lying down doesn't lower tuition, it turns out.

text.id: Kamu chat Pak Haryo minta jadwal kuis susulan. Centang biru. Tiga hari. Satu minggu. Masih centang biru.
text.en: You message Pak Haryo about a make-up quiz. Blue ticks. Three days. One week. Still blue ticks.

label.id: Chat lagi dengan salam super sopan

result.id: Dibalas: "Ok." Hanya "Ok." Tapi itu cukup.
result.en: Reply: "Ok." Just "Ok." But it's enough.

fail_result.id: Di-read lagi. Kali ini beliau sempat ganti foto profil.
fail_result.en: Read again. This time he even updated his profile picture.

label.en: Go to his office in person

result.id: Beruntung, beliau ada! Urusan beres dalam 2 menit.
result.en: Lucky, he's there! Sorted in 2 minutes.

fail_result.id: Pintu terkunci. Tulisan "Sedang Rapat" tertempel sejak 2021.
fail_result.en: Locked door. A "In a Meeting" sign has hung there since 2021.

text.id: "Buku saya edisi ke-7 wajib dibeli. 150 ribu. Yang tidak punya, tidak boleh ikut remedial."
text.en: "My textbook, 7th edition, is mandatory. 150K. No book, no remedial exam."

result.id: Isinya sama persis dengan edisi 6. Cuma ganti cover dan harga.
result.en: It's identical to the 6th edition. Only the cover and price changed.

result.id: Aman. Kamu menghemat 120 ribu.
result.en: Safe. You saved 120K.

fail_result.id: Ketahuan! "Kamu tidak menghargai karya intelektual saya."
fail_result.en: Caught! "You don't respect my intellectual work."

result.id: Prodi menegur beliau. Kewajiban dicabut, tapi beliau ingat wajahmu.
result.en: The department reprimands him. Mandate dropped, but he remembers your face.

fail_result.id: Laporan "sedang diproses". Nilaimu juga "sedang diproses".
fail_result.en: Report "being processed". Your grade is also "being processed".

text.id: Dosen killer masuk kelas 45 menit telat. Lalu mengusir mahasiswa yang telat 2 menit.
text.en: The strict lecturer arrives 45 minutes late. Then kicks out a student who was 2 minutes late.

result.id: Kamu menulis di buku: "Sabar itu SKS tak terlihat."
result.en: You write in your notebook: "Patience is an invisible credit unit."

result.id: Temanmu ngakak tanpa suara. Bonding tercipta.
result.en: Your friend laughs silently. A bond is formed.

fail_result.id: "KAMU yang ngobrol, keluar!" Absenmu dicoret.
fail_result.en: "YOU, the one talking, out!" Your attendance is crossed out.

text.id: Dosen tidak datang. Info di grup: "Kuliah diganti tugas resume 20 halaman, kumpul besok pagi."
text.en: The lecturer doesn't show up. Group chat: "Class replaced with a 20-page summary, due tomorrow morning."

result.id: Selesai jam 2 pagi. Tangan pegal, hati bangga.
result.en: Done at 2 a.m. Sore hands, proud heart.

result.id: Lolos! Dosennya juga nggak baca.
result.en: It passed! The lecturer didn't read it either.

fail_result.id: Ketahuan: nama kating masih ada di header.
fail_result.en: Caught: the senior's name was still in the header.

text.id: SIAKAD error 504 tepat 5 menit sebelum deadline upload tugas.
text.en: The academic portal throws a 504 error exactly 5 minutes before the upload deadline.

label.en: Email it with an error screenshot

result.id: Dosen menerima. Screenshot adalah senjata mahasiswa.
result.en: The lecturer accepts it. Screenshots are a student's weapon.

fail_result.id: "Itu bukan urusan saya." Tugas dianggap tidak dikumpul.
fail_result.en: "Not my problem." Assignment marked as missing.

result.id: Masuk di detik ke-59! Adrenalin level dewa.
result.en: Uploaded at second 59! God-tier adrenaline.

fail_result.id: Server baru pulih jam 00.01. Telat 1 menit.
fail_result.en: The server recovers at 00:01. One minute late.

text.id: Kamu butuh tanda tangan surat aktif kuliah. Pak Darto: "Besok aja ya, Dik. Bapak lagi istirahat." (Ini jam 10.15.)
text.en: You need a signed proof-of-enrollment letter. Pak Darto: "Come back tomorrow. I'm on my break." (It's 10:15 a.m.)

result.id: Besoknya beres! Sebuah keajaiban birokrasi.
result.en: Done the next day! A bureaucratic miracle.

fail_result.id: Besoknya: "Yang tanda tangan lagi cuti, Dik."
fail_result.en: Next day: "The signatory is on leave."

result.id: Langsung ditandatangani. Gorengan adalah kunci birokrasi.
result.en: Signed instantly. Fritters are the key to bureaucracy.

fail_result.id: Gorengannya dimakan. Suratnya tetap besok.
fail_result.en: He eats the fritters. The letter is still tomorrow.

text.id: Legalisir harus cap basah, 3 rangkap, pakai map biru tua. "Bukan biru muda ya, Dik."
text.en: Certification requires wet stamps, 3 copies, in a dark blue folder. "Not light blue."

result.id: Diterima! Setelah antre 2 jam.
result.en: Accepted! After a 2-hour queue.

result.id: Lolos! Pak Darto sedang tidak pakai kacamata.
result.en: It passed! Pak Darto wasn't wearing his glasses.

fail_result.id: Ditolak. "Ulang besok, Dik."
fail_result.en: Rejected. "Try again tomorrow."

text.id: Kampus mau akreditasi! Semua mahasiswa wajib pakai almamater dan tersenyum ke asesor. Toilet tiba-tiba direnovasi.
text.en: Accreditation visit! Everyone must wear the campus jacket and smile at the assessors. The toilets are suddenly renovated.

result.id: Asesor terkesan. Dekan ingat namamu (salah eja, tapi tetap).
result.en: The assessors are impressed. The dean remembers your name (misspelled, but still).

result.id: Kantin sepi. Surga.
result.en: The canteen is empty. Paradise.

text.id: Di akhir kelas, dosen killer tiba-tiba curhat: dosen juga tenggelam di laporan BKD, akreditasi, dan rapat tanpa akhir.
text.en: After class, the strict lecturer suddenly vents: lecturers are drowning in workload reports, accreditation and endless meetings too.

result.id: Ternyata dosen juga korban sistem. Beliau tersenyum untuk pertama kalinya.
result.en: Turns out lecturers are victims of the system too. She smiles for the first time.

result.id: Kamu melewatkan momen langka itu.
result.en: You missed a rare moment.

text.id: Jam 23.07, pesan masuk: "Besok jam 7 pagi ke ruangan saya." Tanpa konteks.
text.en: 11:07 p.m., a message arrives: "Come to my office at 7 a.m. tomorrow." No context.

result.id: Beliau datang jam 10. Tapi senang kamu rajin.
result.en: He arrives at 10. But he's pleased you're diligent.

fail_result.id: Beliau tidak datang sama sekali. Pesan berikutnya: "Besok saja."
fail_result.en: He never shows. Next message: "Tomorrow instead."

result.id: Ternyata cuma minta tolong angkat proyektor.
result.en: Turns out he just needed help carrying a projector.

text.id: Temanmu nawarin: "Bolos aja, nanti aku titip absenin."
text.en: Your friend offers: "Skip class, I'll sign you in."

result.id: Aman. Kamu tercatat hadir sambil rebahan.
result.en: Safe. Marked present while lying in bed.

fail_result.id: Dosen memanggil nama satu-satu. Ketahuan!
fail_result.en: The lecturer calls names one by one. Busted!

result.id: Integritas terjaga. Kantuk juga terjaga.
result.en: Integrity intact. Sleepiness also intact.

text.id: DM masuk: "Jasa joki tugas & skripsi. Murah, amanah, bergaransi. Ready semua prodi."
text.en: A DM arrives: "Assignment & thesis ghostwriting. Cheap, trustworthy, guaranteed. All majors."

result.id: Tugas beres... tapi kamu tidak paham isinya sama sekali.
result.en: Assignment done... but you don't understand any of it.

fail_result.id: Turnitin: 98% plagiat. Kamu dipanggil prodi.
fail_result.en: Plagiarism checker: 98% match. The department summons you.

result.id: Integritas +100. Tidak ada di stat, tapi kamu tahu.
result.en: Integrity +100. Not on your stats, but you know.

text.id: Seorang "oknum" berbisik: "Nilai A bisa diatur. Transfer saja, aman."
text.en: A shady "someone" whispers: "An A can be arranged. Just transfer the money, it's safe."

result.id: Nilai "aman". Untuk sekarang.
result.en: Grades "secured". For now.

fail_result.id: Kasus jual-beli nilai terbongkar. Semua yang terlibat di-DO.
fail_result.en: The grade-selling scheme is exposed. Everyone involved is expelled.

result.id: Oknum itu diperiksa. Kampus sedikit lebih bersih.
result.en: The person is investigated. Campus is a little cleaner.

fail_result.id: Laporanmu "hilang" di meja seseorang.
fail_result.en: Your report "went missing" on someone's desk.

text.id: Tugas kelompok 5 orang. Dimas baru muncul H-1 presentasi: "Bagian gue yang mana ya?"
text.en: A 5-person group project. Dimas shows up the day before the presentation: "So which part is mine?"

result.id: Selesai. Nama Dimas tetap tercantum. Hidup memang begitu.
result.en: Done. Dimas's name is still on it. That's life.

label.en: Remove his name from the report

result.id: Dosen mengapresiasi kejujuranmu.
result.en: The lecturer appreciates your honesty.

fail_result.id: Grup jadi drama. Dimas bikin story galau.
fail_result.en: Group drama ensues. Dimas posts a sad story.

result.id: Dimas bawa laptop. Tanpa charger.
result.en: Dimas brings the laptop. Without the charger.

text.id: "Kamu udah baca 3 jurnal buat minggu depan? Aku udah 12."
text.en: "Have you read the 3 journal papers for next week? I've read 12."

result.id: Ternyata Nadia baik. Cuma ambisnya volume maksimal.
result.en: Turns out Nadia is nice. Her ambition is just on max volume.

result.id: Nadia menatapmu seperti melihat alien.
result.en: Nadia stares at you like you're an alien.

text.id: Kamu dicalonkan jadi Ketua Himpunan Mahasiswa!
text.en: You've been nominated for Student Association President!

result.id: Terpilih! Jadwal rapatmu sekarang 3x lipat.
result.en: Elected! Your meeting schedule just tripled.

result.id: Kamu tetap aktif tanpa beban jabatan.
result.en: You stay active without the burden of office.

text.id: Seorang dosen mengajakmu ikut lomba nasional. Deadline proposal: minggu depan.
text.en: A lecturer invites you to a national competition. Proposal deadline: next week.

result.id: JUARA 2 NASIONAL! Hadiah 1 juta dan sertifikat.
result.en: 2ND PLACE NATIONALLY! 1 million prize and a certificate.

fail_result.id: Belum juara, tapi dosen mulai kenal kamu.
fail_result.en: No prize, but the lecturer knows you now.

result.id: Fokus itu juga strategi.
result.en: Focus is also a strategy.

text.id: Seminar nasional GRATIS! Dapat sertifikat, snack box, dan nasi kotak.
text.en: FREE national seminar! Certificate, snack box and a boxed lunch.

result.id: Materinya lumayan. Nasi kotaknya juara.
result.en: The talk was okay. The boxed lunch was champion-tier.

result.id: Kamu tidur siang dengan damai.
result.en: You take a peaceful nap.

text.id: Grup WhatsApp kelas ribut soal pembagian kelompok. 287 pesan belum dibaca.
text.en: The class WhatsApp group is fighting over group assignments. 287 unread messages.

result.id: Debat selesai tanpa keputusan. Seperti rapat pada umumnya.
result.en: The debate ends with no decision. Like every meeting.

label.en: Mute the group for a week

result.id: Damai.
result.en: Peace.

fail_result.id: Damai... sampai kamu sadar ketinggalan info kuis.
fail_result.en: Peaceful... until you realize you missed the quiz announcement.

text.id: Kamu jadi panitia ospek. Seorang maba bertanya polos: "Kak, kuliah itu enak nggak?"
text.en: You're on the orientation committee. A freshman asks innocently: "Is college fun?"

result.id: Maba itu mengangguk pelan. Kamu baru saja menjadi Bang Jarwo versi baru.
result.en: The freshman nods slowly. You've just become the new Bang Jarwo.

result.id: Bohong demi kebaikan. Kamu tersenyum getir.
result.en: A white lie. You smile bitterly.

text.id: "Kamu lagi glowing banget sih akhir-akhir ini. Rahasianya apa?"
text.en: "You've been glowing lately. What's your secret?"

result.id: Social campus balance: unlocked.
result.en: Social campus balance: unlocked.

text.id: Kucing kampus tidur di atas laptopmu, persis di tombol Delete.
text.en: The campus cat falls asleep on your laptop, right on the Delete key.

result.id: Paragraf terakhirmu hilang, tapi hatimu hangat.
result.en: Your last paragraph is gone, but your heart is warm.

result.id: Si kucing pindah ke tasmu. Kompromi.
result.en: The cat relocates to your bag. A compromise.

text.id: Notifikasi tengah malam: FLASH SALE! Hoodie ungu lucu diskon 70%, sisa 3 lagi!
text.en: Midnight notification: FLASH SALE! Cute purple hoodie 70% off, only 3 left!

result.id: Paket datang 3 hari kemudian. Dompet menangis, hati senang. (Hoodie masuk Lemari.)
result.en: The package arrives 3 days later. Wallet crying, heart happy. (Hoodie added to your Wardrobe.)

result.id: Kamu kuat. Kamu sigma.
result.en: You're strong. You're sigma.

text.id: "Nak, udah makan belum? Kapan pulang? Jangan lupa salat/ibadah ya."
text.en: "Have you eaten, dear? When are you coming home? Don't forget to pray."

result.id: Ibu mendengarkan. "Capek boleh, menyerah jangan dulu."
result.en: Mom listens. "It's okay to be tired, just don't give up yet."

result.id: Ibu tahu kamu bohong. Ibu selalu tahu.
result.en: Mom knows you're lying. Moms always know.

text.id: "Maaf ya, Nak, kiriman bulan ini cuma segini. Ayah masih cari kerja."
text.en: "Sorry, dear, this month's allowance is all we could send. Dad is still job hunting."

label.id: "Nggak apa-apa, Bu. Aku kerja part-time kok."

result.id: Ibu menangis pelan di telepon. Kamu juga, setelah teleponnya ditutup.
result.en: Mom cries softly on the phone. So do you, after hanging up.

label.en: Send a little money back (100 coins)

result.id: "Kamu sudah besar ya, Nak."
result.en: "You've really grown up, dear."

text.id: "Galon kos habis, gantian beli ya. Sekalian token listrik."
text.en: "The water gallon is empty, it's your turn to buy. And the electricity token."

result.id: Bu Endang memberimu pisang goreng sebagai bonus.
result.en: Bu Endang gives you fried bananas as a bonus.

result.id: Berhasil! Anak kamar sebelah yang kena.
result.en: It worked! The kid next door got stuck with it.

fail_result.id: Bu Endang mengetuk pintu selama 15 menit. Kamu menyerah.
fail_result.en: Bu Endang knocks for 15 minutes. You give in.

text.id: Mas warkop: "Bon kamu udah 15 gelas lho, Mas/Mbak."
text.en: The warkop owner: "Your tab is up to 15 coffees, you know."

result.id: "Sip, sisanya pas kiriman ya."
result.en: "Cool, the rest when your allowance arrives."

result.id: Mas warkop mengangguk. Matanya tidak.
result.en: He nods. His eyes don't.

text.id: SMS: "Butuh dana cepat? DanaKilat cair 5 menit! Tanpa jaminan!"
text.en: SMS: "Need cash fast? DanaKilat pays out in 5 minutes! No collateral!"

result.id: Cair. Bunganya juga cair. Utang 1.500 ditagih awal semester depan.
result.en: Money's in. So is the interest. 1,500 debt due next semester.

result.id: Keputusan finansial terbaik bulan ini.
result.en: Best financial decision of the month.

text.id: Debt collector DanaKilat menghubungi semua kontakmu. Termasuk dosen pembimbing akademikmu.
text.en: DanaKilat's debt collector contacts everyone in your phone. Including your academic advisor.

label.en: Hide your face in a pillow

result.id: Pelajaran mahal: pinjol bukan solusi.
result.en: An expensive lesson: loan apps aren't a solution.

text.id: Libur tengah semester. Ibu masak rendang. Pulang kampung?
text.en: Mid-semester break. Mom is cooking rendang. Go home?

result.id: Rendang Ibu menyembuhkan segalanya. Hampir.
result.en: Mom's rendang heals everything. Almost.

result.id: Kos sepi. Tugas maju. Rindu juga maju.
result.en: The boarding house is quiet. Work progresses. So does homesickness.

text.id: Hujan deras, motor matic-mu mogok di depan gerbang kampus.
text.en: Pouring rain, your scooter breaks down at the campus gate.

label.en: Push it to a repair shop (60 coins)

result.id: Basah kuyup, tapi motor hidup lagi.
result.en: Soaked, but the scooter lives again.

label.en: Leave it with security, take a ride

result.id: Pak Satpam menjaga motormu seperti anak sendiri.
result.en: The security guard guards it like his own child.

text.id: Laptopmu bluescreen pas lagi ngerjain tugas besar. Belum di-save.
text.en: Your laptop bluescreens mid-project. Unsaved.

result.id: Hidup lagi. Pelajaran: Ctrl+S tiap 5 detik.
result.en: Back alive. Lesson: Ctrl+S every 5 seconds.

result.id: Kamu mengulang dari nol di laptop orang. Pahit.
result.en: You redo everything on someone else's laptop. Bitter.

text.id: Banjir! Kampus diliburkan mendadak.
text.en: Flood! Campus closes unexpectedly.

result.id: Libur dadakan adalah hadiah terindah.
result.en: Surprise holidays are the best gift.

result.id: Sinyal naik-turun seperti mood dosen.
result.en: The signal goes up and down like a lecturer's mood.

text.id: Badanmu demam tinggi. Kata dokter klinik kampus: gejala tifus, harus istirahat.
text.en: You have a high fever. The campus clinic says: typhoid symptoms, you need rest.

result.id: Tubuhmu berterima kasih. Absen bolong satu.
result.en: Your body thanks you. One absence.

result.id: Kamu hadir secara fisik. Jiwamu di kasur.
result.en: Your body attended. Your soul stayed in bed.

text.id: Dosen memindahkan kelas pengganti ke jam 19.00 — tepat jam shift kerjamu. BENTROK!
text.en: The lecturer moves a make-up class to 7 p.m. — exactly your work shift. CLASH!

result.id: Ilmu dapat, gaji kepotong. Bos mencatat izinmu.
result.en: Knowledge gained, pay docked. The boss logs your absence.

result.id: Kamu dianggap tidak hadir. Kehadiranmu makin tipis.
result.en: Marked absent. Your attendance gets thinner.

text.id: Kuliah pengganti dadakan jam 13.00. Kamu ada shift les privat jam segitu.
text.en: Surprise make-up class at 1 p.m. You have a tutoring shift then.

result.id: Murid lesmu kecewa. Dosen tidak sadar kamu hadir.
result.en: Your student is disappointed. The lecturer didn't notice you came.

result.id: Absen bolong satu. Dompet aman.
result.en: One absence. Wallet safe.

text.id: "Besok lembur ya, pas jam kuliah pagi kamu. Dibayar dobel!"
text.en: "Overtime tomorrow, during your morning class. Double pay!"

result.id: Uang masuk. Absen keluar.
result.en: Money in. Attendance out.

result.id: "Oke, paham. Kuliah yang bener ya."
result.en: "Okay, I get it. Study hard."
